face_to_path_deg.name: face_to_path_deg
face_to_path_deg.points_at: Neither a repeatable miss nor scatter beyond what this instrument's own error explains. That is not a clean bill — it is that nothing here can be distinguished from noise at this sample size.

finish_balance_norm.name: finish_balance_norm
finish_balance_norm.points_at: A miss that repeats at about the same size every swing. Whatever produces it is the same every time, which points at something already set before the swing starts rather than at something that happens during it. None of that is visible here, so the test is empirical: change one thing at setup, hit another set, and see whether the center moves.

head_sway_norm.name: head_sway_norm
head_sway_norm.points_at: Neither a repeatable miss nor scatter beyond what this instrument's own error explains. That is not a clean bill — it is that nothing here can be distinguished from noise at this sample size.

hip_sway_norm.name: hip_sway_norm
unavailable: no target for hip_sway_norm: 'less is better' is not established for it — some lateral hip travel is a weight shift rather than a fault, and nothing here knows how much. It has a two-sided band as of 2026-08-12, which is a range rather than a target: `analysis.comparison` asks whether the personal center sits inside it, so no point value has to be invented here

launch_angle_deg.name: launch_angle_deg
unavailable: no target for launch_angle_deg: optimal launch is per club, per ball speed and per spin rate, so a single number for it would be wrong for every club in the bag. Same missing model as ball speed and the same deferral
